nom: Paula's Choice 6 % Mandelic Acid + 2 % Lactic Acid Liquid Exfoliant

avis.titre: Works but will break you out
avis.texte: If you're looking for a product that's going to get rid of all your dirt, oil , ect , that's been hiding deep under your Skin for years. This is the product for you. However, you will immediately break out and look like pizza face for 4-6 weeks. Do your research and don't mix certain products while using this at the same time. It's been two weeks and my purging phase is coming to an end for me . My face feels a lot cleaner and smoother. Would recommend if used correctly.

avis.titre: Nice cool feeling on my face and no sticky residue left at all.
avis.texte: I’ve been using this for almost two weeks. It feels nice putting it on my face. It’s cool, clear and watery but I can tell there’s some really healthy ingredients. Once it’s on my face for a few minutes I can feel it, it’s hard to explain what I feel. It’s not uncomfortable at all. Almost like a little tingly. I have noticed a brighter glow just in the short time I’ve used it. Even though I exfoliate my face in the shower I feel like this does as well. It soaks into my skin right away. No greasy, sticky or tacky feeling at all. Feels like the consistency of water. I love knowing I’m putting clean, healthy ingredients on my skin. I’m excited to see more changes the longer I use it. I’d definitely recommend.

I’m just giving it four stars for now because I just received it. I’ve only used it once but being the first time that I use it, I noticed my skin felt tighter. And I have some light forehead lines and they look less noticeable. I think I’m gonna like this product.

I love love this product! I have sensitive skin that breaks out and does not tolerate just about every product. But, Paula's products are perfect for my dry, sensitive, and almost 50 year old skin. My skin is clear, soft, radiant

This is the absolute best face exfoliator. I have very sensitive skin and was able to use it nightly without irritation. I currently alternate nights with this and retinol and it's been great for my skin. It really helps with breakouts, discoloration, and visible pores.

I have rosacea, so a lot of products trigger flares and breakouts. This one does not! When I put it on at night after a shower, I wake up with a beautiful taught glowing skin. An excellent exfoliant to alternate with azalaic acid (which is also great for rosacea skin).

This was recommended by an esthetician for small acne bumps on my face and chest. Using this in the evening a few times a week before using 10% Adela’s acid treatment has helped clear up issues I had. Not sure if it’s this product or using both together but something’s working

Wow the smell - give me this in a perfume bottle. It’s a milky sweet smell. In terms of the product it’s gentle but effective. I prefer it to the other exfoliant. It’s suitable for my red sensitive skin.

„Es kommt in so einer kleinen und winzigen Flasche! Und ich habe für nur 30 ml ganze 25 Euro bezahlt. Sehr irreführend – wegen der großen Flasche auf dem Bild war es unmöglich zu erkennen. Auch wenn ich mich beschwere, glaube ich nicht, dass sie es zurücknehmen werden, aber ich hoffe, dass es sonst niemand kauft!
This product definitely worked for me my skin is smoother and less irritated. For reference I have a dark complexion.
Affordable and great range of products, not harsh on the skin but very effective

I’m honestly amazed this has been working. I have tired everything to lighten my acne scars and nothing has helped. The only other thing that has helped has been glycolic acid but it really didn’t lighten them. This mandelic acid has also decreased my bumps!

I bought this small battle to try it first and I’m not gonna lie after a week I started seeing a difference in my texture. It’s eating up almost all the leftover dead skin from my retinol, which is really appreciated. It blended in my skin care routine so well. You really need this if you’re fighting with texture, ingrown hairs and bumps…
Started using this after my esthetician recommended it. My skin has never been more healthy!

The Paula’s choice 6% mandelic acid + 2% lactic acid exfoliant comes in liquid form. I use it after I cleanse my face. It’s easier to pour a little on a cotton pad to use. It stings a little bit but the feeling disappears quickly. I try not to use it with other actives such as retinol because I have sensitive skin. My skin does feel smoother after a few uses and I feel that it is easier to put on foundation.
I love this exfoliant, I’ve been using it to reduce the dark scars from ingrown hairs and it has worked amazing. Highly recommend
Best way to exfoliate skin, specially for sensitive skin. I really see the improvement in terms of texture and brightness. Absolutely loved it, definitely one of my favorite skincare products.

avis.texte: as of May 28th 2026 only size and price Too expensive for such a small bottle ..actual product review soon to come
I have only Used this 4 times so far, and I am already seeing a HUGE difference in my pores, the softness of my skin, and my wrinkles. I’m not even up to the daily usage yet

avis.titre: Tiny. Is a joke. Sample/free gift w purchase style.
avis.texte: Is tiny don’t buy this. Go for the full size. Don’t waste your money.

avis.titre: BE SO FOR REAL RIGHT NOW 🤣
avis.texte: BEWARE! Be so for real right now! 🤣🤣🤣 I got bamboozeled on the sizing LOL
Product looks used. The seal on the cap is filthy and looks like it was pulled off then put back on.

avis.titre: You’re paying 15 dollars for a sample size.
avis.texte: I was charged 15 dollars for a sample size. I recognize I should have looked further into the sizing before purchasing, but that’s extortion.

avis.titre: Like it okay, but REALLY expensive???
avis.texte: My review is for the Paula’s Choice 6% Mandelic Acid + 2% Lactic Acid Exfoliant, Gentle Daily AHA Exfoliation for Discoloration, Bumpy Texture & Radiance, for Sensitive Skin, Fragrance-Free & Paraben-Free, 3 Fl. Oz. This was actually my first Paula's Choice product, and I knew of the brand previously and knew it had a strong reputation. I like the subtle scent. It does not irritate my often-sensitive skin. I can't tell if there are really noticable results since I use so many different products depending on the day. But I know I will use all 3 ounces (yes, this is ONLY 3 ounces, for nearly $40!!!) off and on over the next few months. I do wish this had been security sealed. It has a loose sticker on the lid to the bottle, but mine was not secure, and so who knows if this really is sanitary like this. Basically, it seems for a VERY premium product they chose not to spend a fraction of a cent to properly seal it. That doesn't sit well with me.

I am extremely pleased with Paula’s Choice 6% Mandelic Acid + 2% Lactic Acid Exfoliant! The product has a pleasant scent and the formula is gentle yet effective on my sensitive skin. I have noticed great improvements in my skin's texture, discoloration, and overall radiance since using this exfoliant. It definitely works well and has become a staple in my skincare routine. 5 stars!

This is way smaller than I expected..never something you want to have to say...lul. No, but anyways, I don't know how it is going to work on my face, I usually love Paula's Choice products so I'm sure it will work great but just so you know, the bottle is super tiny, like have the size of my Samsung phone, if that helps. For 15 bucks, it's really just up to you if you want to try it out so you don't have to spend nearly 40 bucks on the full size.

avis.titre: TRAVEL SIZE! This is a product that works decently.
avis.texte: TRAVEL SIZE! This is a product that works decently. However, I'm posting this pic so people can get a true sense of what they are spending fifteen bucks on. Make sure you really want/like this product, and then, I'd suggest buying a full size bottle which is far better value.

I was excited to try this to brighten my skin. I did a test area on my face and all went well. I then applied the product to my whole face and neck. This exfoliant burned the skin on my neck and also caused red spots that became really itchy. It has taken 3 weeks for it to get better. I am not sure how well this product works as I only used it once. Be careful. This is strong stuff.

One can’t still wrapped and looked brand new. The other was unwrapped and dirty. I’m pretty sure it was a return. I’ll be sending it back. They are also smaller than expected. It’s not worth the price

Two stars is generous! As you can see from the picture I took that it is the SAME size as the many SAMPLES I get at my derms office and I paid about $15 for ithis…just crazzzy!! It comes out of the teeny bottle like water and applies like water…NOT LIKE SERUM. . I’ve only used it once so I can’t say as to any benefits yet but if I notice any change (which is really doubtful for this size) I’ll reevaluate my rating. Never again for this product at this size!
Was not aware the bottle was smaller than my hand??? $15 for that size is insane. Will not be buying again and might even try to get a refund, as it did NOT look that way in the advertised photo.

I have not used the product yet. I am a little sketched out to be completely honest. The bottle came with no wrap or packaging from the brand. There was a very loose dirty sticker on the bottle and lid both. The bottle does not feel full to me either. From such a reputable brand and for the cost of the product im surprised because this looks like it came from a flea market. Pictures don’t quite do it justice as i had already removed the sticker but oh well. I should have read the reviews before buying.
DIDNT EVEN USE THE PRODUCT BC THE SIZE SEEMED LIKE A JOKE TO RISK IT NOT WORKING. This is like a ultra mini SAMPLE they are selling for $16 . BE SO FR.
